versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to core functionality or documentation.

- Initial release of the 医药知识图谱 skill (version 1.0.0)
- Provides a medical knowledge graph focused on diseases, drugs, symptoms, diagnoses, complications, diet, and their relationships
- Requires users to provide an API key before use; prompts the user if not configured
- Allows schema queries and read access to the graph database using dedicated tool functions
- Includes strict workflow and parameter-checking rules to ensure correct tool selection and API usage
- Emphasizes data integrity by prohibiting fabricated responses when API key is missing
